snippet:
- Unlimited: Core features including Authentication and Authorization, Event Subscription, and Contacts are free to use, regardless of your Lark plan.
- Basic: This covers most Lark features. Usage is tallied, and heavy users may need to consider a higher-tier Lark plan to avoid restrictions.
- Advanced: Pricing for these APIs is usage-based. To access them, you'll need to buy a dedicated quota package.
- For all the details, read [Policy Update: Adjusting API Call Limits for Custom Apps](https://open.larksuite.com/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/api-call-guide/api-billing?lang=en-US).

title: Adjusting API call limits for custom apps - Server API - Documentation - Lark Developer
snippet:
Starting from January 8, 2025, the server-side API will be categorized into **Unlimited API**, **Basic API**, and **Advanced API** categories, with different billing rules based on these categories.
## Adjustment details
The server-side API will be divided into **Unlimited API**, **Basic API**, and **Advanced API** categories, with different billing rules for each type.
### Unlimited API
API calls for the following services by enterprise custom apps will not be metered or charged and can be used for free.If historical versions of free APIs exist, calls to those historical versions will also not be metered or charged.
- [Authentication and Authorization](https://open.larksuite.com/document/common-capabilities/sso/api/obtain-oauth-code)
- [Event Subscription](https://open.larksuite.com/document/ukTMukTMukTM/uUTNz4SN1MjL1UzM)
- [Contacts](https://open.larksuite.com/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/reference/contact-v3/resources)
- [AI](https://open.larksuite.com/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/document_ai-v1/jp_driving_license/recognize)

| Lark version | API call quota description |
|---|---|
| Starter | The total number of basic API calls for all enterprise self-built applications under a single tenant is limited to **10,000 times per month**, which resets on the 1st of each calendar month. The total limit of basic API calls for self-built applications for both uncertified and certified enterprises in the Standard Edition is 10,000 times per month. |
| - Basic - PRO - Enterprise | Unlimited API call quota. |
